meta_description: Essex Plumbing & Heating in Chelmsford. Gas Safe registered plumbing and heating repairs, installations, and emergencies. Call us now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? Boiler broken before winter? We're here within the hour, any day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Chelmsford
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full central heating installations, we handle every job with the same care and attention.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, day or night. We carry parts on the van and aim to have you back to normal within an hour of arrival.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler fitted with full certification and a 10-year guarantee on most units. Broken boiler? We diagnose the fault and repair or replace it the same day.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New heating systems designed for your home's size and layout. We handle the full install, testing, and commissioning so your system runs efficiently all winter.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework Installation
services.desc: Adding radiators, upgrading pipework, or relocating systems to suit your renovation. All work tested and certified to Building Regulations.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Supply and install taps, sinks, and full bathroom suites. We manage water pressure, drainage, and finishing so everything works perfectly from day one.

services.title: Leaks & Water Damage Response
services.desc: Identify the source of leaks and stop the damage fast. We use thermal imaging where needed and repair or replace damaged pipework and fittings.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of cowboys charging my neighbours extortionate rates.
about_para_1: Essex Plumbing & Heating was founded on a simple promise: fix it right the first time, charge a fair price, and answer the phone when customers need us. With over 15 years' experience and Gas Safe certification, we've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time across Chelmsford and the surrounding areas.
about_para_2: We've completed thousands of jobs — from late-night emergency repairs to full heating system overhauls. Our customers come back because we show up on time, we explain what's wrong without the jargon, and we leave your home clean and tidy. That consistency is why word-of-mouth still drives most of our work.
reviews_heading: What Chelmsford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called about a burst pipe at 11pm on a Sunday. I didn't expect anyone to answer, let alone come out. Mark arrived at 12:30, fixed the pipe, and charged a fair rate. Couldn't ask for more. Already booked him for the boiler service next month.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had my old boiler replaced with a new Worcester model. The install took a day and a half, everything explained clearly, and they left no mess. Heating bills are already noticeably lower and the new boiler is so quiet. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: New bathroom fitted by Essex Plumbing. All the pipework hidden, taps and shower working perfectly, and they sorted a small leak we didn't even know about. Really professional, no faffing about, and they finished on time. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James C.
